```{r -Pi-Scer-t0060-Deseq-Analysis, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Automatically select all t0000 and t0015 replicates
rownames(Scer) <- Scer$gene_id
Scer0060min<- grep("t0000|t0060", colnames(Scer), value = TRUE)
sc0060min <- Scer[, Scer0060min]
sc0060min <- as.data.frame(lapply(sc0060min, as.integer))
rownames(sc0060min) <- rownames(Scer)


######################### DESeq

# Define sample metadata based on column names
conditions <- ifelse(grepl("t0000", Scer0060min), "untreated", "treated")
sc0060mins_coldata <- data.frame(
  row.names = Scer0060min,
  condition = factor(conditions, levels = c("untreated", "treated"))
)
############### Add biological replicate labels (to group technical replicates)
# This assigns replicate groups: 1,1,2,2,3,3,4,4
replicate_ids <- rep(paste0("sample", 1:4), each = 2)

sc0060mins_coldata$sample <- replicate_ids
sc0060mins_coldata$run <- rownames(sc0060mins_coldata)  # must match colnames of count matrix

########### Create DESeqDataSet and collapse technical replicates
# Create DESeqDataSet with full colData (including technical replicate info)
scdds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = sc0060min,
                              colData = sc0060mins_coldata,
                              design = ~ condition)

# Collapse technical replicates by summing counts
scdds_collapsed <- collapseReplicates(scdds,
                                    groupby = sc0060mins_coldata$sample,
                                    run = sc0060mins_coldata$run)

# Update condition info (after collapse, only one col per sample remains)
colData(scdds_collapsed)$condition <- colData(scdds)[!duplicated(sc0060mins_coldata$sample), "condition"]

# Run DESeq2 and shrink fold changes
scdds_collapsed <- DESeq(scdds_collapsed)
sc_res <- results(scdds_collapsed, contrast = c("condition", "treated", "untreated"))

##resultsNames(scdds_collapsed)
resLFCsc <- lfcShrink(scdds_collapsed,
                    coef = "condition_treated_vs_untreated", 
                    type = "apeglm")
########## Filter for Significant DE Genes
resSigsc <- subset(resLFCsc, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 2)
resSigsc1 <- subset(resLFCsc, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)

# Write to CSV
write.csv(as.data.frame(resSigsc),
          file = file.path(Scer_results, "20250725Scer.LFCgt2.padjlt0.05.csv"))

write.csv(as.data.frame(resSigsc1),
          file = file.path(Scer_results, "20250725Scer.LFCgt1.padjlt0.05.csv"))

# Run rlog transformation
rld_sc <- rlog(scdds_collapsed, blind = TRUE)
rld_mat_sc <- assay(rld_sc)

# PCA calculation
pca_sc <- prcomp(t(rld_mat_sc))
percentVar <- round(100 * (pca_sc$sdev^2 / sum(pca_sc$sdev^2)))

# Extract sample info
sc_sample_info <- as.data.frame(colData(scdds_collapsed))
sc_sample_info$sample <- rownames(sc_sample_info)

# PCA data frame
df_pca <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_sc$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_sc$x[, 2],
  sample = rownames(pca_sc$x),
  group = sc_sample_info$condition
)

# PCA plot
ScerPCA1 <- ggplot(df_pca, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 6, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - Scer t0000 vs t0060",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", percentVar[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", percentVar[2], "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm")
  ) +
  xlim(-25, 25) +
  ylim(-7, 7)

ScerPCA1
ggsave(filename = file.path(Scer_plots, "PCA_Scer_t0000_vs_t0060.pdf"),
       plot = ScerPCA1, width = 8, height = 6)

# p-value histogram
#pdf(file.path(Scer_plots, "Histogram_pvalue_Scer.pdf"))
hist(resLFCsc$pvalue,
     breaks = 50, col = "grey",
     main = "Distribution of Raw p-values",
     xlab = "p-values", ylab = "Frequency",
     cex.main = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.2)
#dev.off()

# Adjusted p-value histogram
#pdf(file.path(Scer_plots, "Histogram_padj_Scer.pdf"))
hist(resLFCsc$padj,
     breaks = 50, col = "grey",
     main = "Distribution of Adjusted p-values (FDR)",
     xlab = "FDR", ylab = "Frequency",
     cex.main = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.2)
#dev.off()

# MA plot
#pdf(file.path(Scer_plots, "MA_plot_Scer.pdf"))
plotMA(resLFCsc, main = "MA Plot - Scer t0000 vs t0060", cex = 0.5)
#dev.off()

# Volcano plot
lfc_threshold <- 2
pval_threshold <- 0.05

tab <- data.frame(
  logFC = resLFCsc$log2FoldChange,
  negLogPval = -log10(resLFCsc$padj)
)

sig <- with(tab, abs(logFC) > lfc_threshold & negLogPval > -log10(pval_threshold))
#pdf(file.path(Scer_plots, "Volcano_plot_Scer.pdf"))
plot(tab, pch = 16, cex = 0.5,
     xlab = expression(bold(log[2]~fold~change)),
     ylab = expression(bold(-log[10]~FDR)),
     main = "Volcano Plot - Scer t0000 vs t0060")
points(tab[sig, ], col = "red", pch = 16, cex = 0.6)
abline(h = -log10(pval_threshold), col = "green3", lty = 2)
abline(v = c(-lfc_threshold, lfc_threshold), col = "blue", lty = 2)
#dev.off()




```


```{r -Pi-Cgla-t0060min-Deseq-analysis, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Prepare count matrix
rownames(Cgla) <- Cgla$gene_id
Cgla0060min <- grep("t0000|t0060", colnames(Cgla), value = TRUE)

)

                                      groupby = cg_coldata$sample,
                                      run = cg_coldata$run)

# Run DESeq and shrink LFC

                      coef = "condition_treated_vs_untreated",
                      type = "apeglm")

# Subset DE genes

resSigcg1 <- subset(resLFCcg, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)

write.csv(as.data.frame(resSigcg1), file = file.path(Cgla_results, "20250725Cgla.LFCgt1.padjlt0.05.csv"))

# rlog and PCA

rld_mat_cg <- assay(rld_cg)

# Recalculate PCA if needed

percentVar_cg <- round(100 * (pca_cg$sdev^2 / sum(pca_cg$sdev^2)))

df_pca_cg <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_cg$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_cg$x[, 2],
  sample = rownames(pca_cg$x),
  group = cg_sample_info$condition
)

# Adjusted PCA plot: auto-scaled axes
CglaPCA1 <- ggplot(df_pca_cg, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 6, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - Cgla t0000 vs t0060",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", percentVar_cg[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", percentVar_cg[2], "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm")
  )
CglaPCA1

# Save new plot
ggsave(filename = file.path(Cgla_plots, "PCA_Cgla_t0000_vs_t0060_adjusted.pdf"),
       plot = CglaPCA1, width = 8, height = 6)


# p-value histogram
pdf(file.path(Cgla_plots, "Histogram_pvalue_Cgla.pdf"))
hist(resLFCcg$pvalue, breaks = 50, col = "grey",
     main = "Distribution of Raw p-values",
     xlab = "p-values", ylab = "Frequency",

abline(h = -log10(pval_threshold), col = "green3", lty = 2)
abline(v = c(-lfc_threshold, lfc_threshold), col = "blue", lty = 2)
```

```{r explore-DEGs-count-plotCount}
# Count significant DEGs
sc_up   <- sum(resSigsc$log2FoldChange > 0)
sc_down <- sum(resSigsc$log2FoldChange < 0)

cg_up   <- sum(resSigcg$log2FoldChange > 0)
cg_down <- sum(resSigcg$log2FoldChange < 0)

calb_up   <- sum(resSigcalb$log2FoldChange > 0)
calb_down <- sum(resSigcalb$log2FoldChange < 0)

klac_up   <- sum(resSigklac$log2FoldChange > 0)
klac_down <- sum(resSigklac$log2FoldChange < 0)

# Combine into a data frame
deg_summary <- data.frame(
  Species = c("Scer", "Cgla", "Calb", "Klac"),
  Upregulated = c(sc_up, cg_up, calb_up, klac_up),
  Downregulated = c(sc_down, cg_down, calb_down, klac_down)
)
deg_summary$Total <- deg_summary$Upregulated + deg_summary$Downregulated

print(deg_summary)

# Convert to long format
deg_long <- deg_summary |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
               names_to = "Direction", values_to = "Count")

# Bar plot
p.sig.Degs <- ggplot(deg_long, aes(x = Species, y = Count, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "tomato", "Downregulated" = "steelblue")) +
  labs(title = "Differentially Expressed Genes by Species",
       y = "Significant DEGs (|LFC| > 2)",
       x = "Species") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
p.sig.Degs
```

```{r functional-analysis-GO-Term-Enrichment}
####### Extract gene lists
Scer_genes <- gsub("^gene-", "", rownames(resSigsc)) # S. cerevisiae
writeLines(Scer_genes, file.path(Scer_results, "20250727Scer_sig_genes_GO.txt"))
Scer_go<- enrichGO(
  gene          = Scer_genes,
  OrgDb         = org.Sc.sgd.db,
  keyType       = "ORF",  # ORF = YPL240C, etc.
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  readable      = FALSE   # ⬅️ prevent SYMBOL conversion
)

# Convert and remove rows with missing values in relevant columns
Scer_GO <- as.data.frame(Scer_go)  
Scer_GO <- Scer_GO[!is.na(Scer_GO$Description) & !is.na(Scer_GO$p.adjust) & !is.na(Scer_GO$Count), ]
Scer_GO[order(Scer_GO$Count, decreasing = TRUE), ][1:20, ]
Scer_GO$Description <- factor(Scer_go$Description, levels = Scer_GO$Description[order(Scer_GO$Count)])

ScGoPlot <- ggplot(Scer_GO, aes(x = Description, y = Count, fill = p.adjust)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue", name = "FDR") +
  labs(title = "Top GO Terms - S. cerevisiae",
       x = NULL, y = "Gene Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
  )

ScGoPlot

ggsave(filename = file.path(Scer_plots, "ScGo Term t0000_vs_t0060.pdf"),
       plot = ScGoPlot, width = 8, height = 6)
############################
########################## using GO term from unipro
Scer_go_map <- read_tsv(here("results", "Scer", "Scer_idmapping_2025_07_30.tsv"))
# Preview the data
#glimpse(Klac_go_map)

# Subset only non-NA GO Biological Process terms
Scer_go_bp <- Scer_go_map %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Gene Ontology (biological process)`)) %>%
  select(`Gene Names`, `Gene Ontology (biological process)`)

# Separate multiple GO terms per row
Scer_go_bp <- Scer_go_bp %>%
  separate_rows(`Gene Ontology (biological process)`, sep = ";\\s*")

# Clean whitespace and extract just the GO term name
Scer_go_bp <- Scer_go_bp%>%
  mutate(`GO Term` = str_remove(`Gene Ontology (biological process)`, "\\s*\\[GO:\\d+\\]")) %>%
  count(`GO Term`, name = "Gene Count") %>%
  arrange(desc(`Gene Count`))

# Optional: Limit to top N GO terms
Scer_go_bp <- Scer_go_bp %>% slice_max(`Gene Count`, n = 20)

# Plot
ScerUniprotGoPlot <- ggplot(Scer_go_bp, aes(x = reorder(`GO Term`, `Gene Count`), y = `Gene Count`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top uniprot GO Biological Process Terms - S.cerevisaie",
       x = NULL, y = "Gene Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

ScerUniprotGoPlot
ggsave(filename = file.path(Scer_plots, "Scer Uniproit Go Term t0000_vs_t0060.pdf"),
       plot = ScerUniprotGoPlot, width = 14, height = 6)
```

```{r orthogroup-Assignment, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
############################# S.cerevisiae 

# Load Scer DEGs results 
#Scer_degs_genes <- read_lines(here("results", "Scer", "20250727Scer_sig_genes_GO.txt"))
# Create a new column that extracts the systematic gene name (first word before space)
orthogroups <- orthogroups %>%
  mutate(SCER_ID = word(S_cerevisiae, 1)) 

# Subset orthogroups that include Scer DEGs
Scer_og <- orthogroups %>%
  filter(SCER_ID %in% Scer_genes)

# Optional: Find genes that didn't match
missing_genes <- setdiff(Scer_genes, Scer_og$SCER_SYS_ID)

# Check how many are unmatched
length(missing_genes)
print(missing_genes)
```
